lines.text: Darius appoints 120 satraps and three administrators, and Daniel stands out, so the king plans to set him over the kingdom.
The officials persuade King Darius to sign a decree that for thirty days anyone who petitions any god or man except him is thrown to the lions.
Daniel prays toward Egypt three times a day, and the men report him to the king.
Darius labors until sundown to rescue Daniel, then has him thrown into the den, and the king seals the stone with his signet ring and fasts.
At dawn Darius hurries to the den, and Daniel says God sent a prophet to shut the lions' mouths.
